newsitem.title: KENYA: Prices easier at Kenyan coffee auction.
newsitem.headline: Prices easier at Kenyan coffee auction.

text.p: Prices were down at the weekly Kenyan export auction on dimished demand, traders said.
Premium grades AAs sold at an average price of $140.5 compared with $149 last week, while ABs traded at an average of $138 against $145.5 at the previous auction.
The market average was $122.43, a coffee official said.
"There was less buying pressure in today's sale, so prices were easier for all grades," an official of the Kenya Coffee Auctions Ltd told Reuters.
The Coffee Board of Kenya said it sold all 40,591 60-kg bags it offered for sale, compared with 41,000 bags last week.
